description: Consists of the principal officer, the Council Secretary, as well as procurement and audit sections.

Plans the overall layout of the district, upgrading of shanty areas, township boundaries, standard building plans, land distribution, title deeds, HIV/AIDS, gender and human rights sensitisation, community development activities, and public health.
Facilitates feeder roads, borehole drilling, inspection of buildings, scrutiny of building plans, burial sites, fire brigade services, and maintenance of plant and machinery.
Collection of revenue, preparation of statutory obligations, and preparation of books of accounts.

Staff establishment, asset management, records keeping, training and development, recruitment, staff appraisals, minutes and report writing, discipline, conditions of service, and public relations services.
Establish and maintain offices, buildings, public meeting facilities and assemblies needed for Council administration.
Maintain law and order, safeguard national security, and promote efficient governance within the Council jurisdiction.
Regulate and control advertisements and advertising devices visible from streets and other public areas.
Regulate livestock movement, animal slaughter, meat certification, disposal of diseased carcasses, hygiene in abattoirs and cold storage, animal by-products, and transport of carcasses.
Develop and maintain road infrastructure, regulate traffic and parking, and implement road-safety measures.
Establish and maintain street lighting systems for safety and accessibility.
Inspect business establishments and enforce compliance, including regulations concerning the sale and consumption of intoxicating liquor.
Construct, purchase and maintain buildings and facilities for residential accommodation and encourage adequate housing development.
Regulate land use and building construction for public health, safety and orderly development, including demolition and removal of buildings.
